stage_intent: future Stage F study; no route registered

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which route identity, placement and prerequisite dispositions govern this future study?
required_preregistration.why_needed: The existing queue does not register this named study.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which falsifiable question and prospective claim, acceptance and inconclusive interpretations will be tested?
required_preregistration.why_needed: A title and mechanism classes do not determine an objective or success predicate.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which system, typed state, units, boundary, initial-state domain and uncorrected dynamics define the study?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Legal actions and accounting depend on the system and boundary.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which observation map or measured quantities, units, resolution, uncertainty, latency and missingness rules are available to each mechanism?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Observation can hide modes; the foundations select no measurement process.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which empirical records and inclusion/provenance rules are admissible for calibration?
required_preregistration.why_needed: No dataset is supplied or authorized for acquisition; simulated data are not empirical observations.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which calibration/validation partition and time-availability rule governs fitting and action inputs?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Independent assessment needs a declared boundary against evaluation or future-data leakage.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which model parameters are estimated under which identifiable observation-to-parameter model?
required_preregistration.why_needed: An estimated model coefficient is not automatically a policy gain or link weight.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which estimator, noise, weighting, regularization and uncertainty/validation contract maps observations to estimates?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Exact inversion, sensitivity and estimation are distinct; none is selected here.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which policy parameters may change by which update law and available inputs, with which effect on physical dynamics?
required_preregistration.why_needed: A diagnostic or estimate does not specify an intervention.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which topology layer or separately typed physical graph may change through which edits or weight updates, with which dynamical meanings?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Structural support does not identify physical edges, measured weights or a best topology.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which cadence, observation-to-action delay, event ordering and application timing govern the three mechanisms?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Changing delay or update order changes the system; no schedule is supplied.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which admissible domains and change bounds apply separately to estimates and policy parameters, including constraint/saturation behavior?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Bounded policy adaptation is required but no legal values or bound-handling rule is frozen for this model.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which topology domain, edit/weight bounds and structural invariants constrain topology actions?
required_preregistration.why_needed: No initial graph, legal edge set, weight domain or change budget is supplied.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which prediction, control and closure errors, references, units, aggregation and uncertainty treatment define the error metrics?
required_preregistration.why_needed: These errors answer different questions; no common loss or tolerance follows.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which typed resource/cost quantities, ownership, aggregation and comparison rules account for all three mechanisms?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Correction accounting does not select monetary weights or a scalar objective across incompatible units.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which model-specific stability/viability constraints and admissibility checks apply to the complete adaptive system and action sequence?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Fixed-gain or fixed-topology results do not establish adaptive stability; closure does not establish viability.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which exact fixed-policy and fixed-topology arms, reference configurations and matched calibration exposure identify the contrasts?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Both controls are required, but their settings and crossing are absent; a doubly fixed baseline alone cannot separate both adaptive effects.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which deterministic/stochastic declaration, seed set, streams and between-arm coupling will be frozen?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Neither randomness nor seed zero is implied; existing seeds belong to their own studies.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which horizon, stopping rules, terminal classifications and treatment of incomplete/interrupted observations are preregistered?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Other studies cannot supply early-stop criteria or terminal interpretation.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which numerical representation, method, precision, error controls and conformance criteria implement the chosen model and estimator?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Existing matrix/scalar diagnostics and serialization profiles have limited scope.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which quantities, boundary flows, residual uncertainty/tolerances and failure dispositions define the accounting profiles?
required_preregistration.why_needed: A typed balance does not select a conserved quantity, completeness assumption or tolerance.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which exact versioned configuration, observation, estimate, action, topology, checkpoint, output and manifest schemas, paths and retention rules realize the evidence?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Conceptual fields are not runtime schemas; applicability and privacy depend on the domain.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which checkpoint state and resume/restart rules preserve information history and the adaptation schedule after interruption?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Estimates, pending actions, topology versions, clocks and any random state need model-specific recovery.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which compute/storage envelope and hard cost cap bound the registered design?
required_preregistration.why_needed: Sizing requires dimensions, arms, cadence and horizon; another route cap cannot authorize this study.

required_preregistration.exact_missing_decision: Which independent result audit and claim-to-artifact sufficiency rules resolve each future claim?
required_preregistration.why_needed: An evidence ladder does not supply study-specific acceptance or publication authority.

mechanism_definitions.definition: Estimate declared model parameters from admissible empirical observations under declared identifiability, noise, estimator and validation contracts. The versioned scientific estimate is distinct from applying a policy or topology action.
Change declared bounded policy parameters through a declared observation-dependent correction law with explicit delay, constraints and effect on physical dynamics.
Apply declared permitted edits or weight actions within a typed topology domain, naming the affected layer or physical relation, dynamical meaning and bounds.

evidence_nonpromotion_rule: No evidence item or disposition may be described as a stronger evidence level than the mechanism that produced it.
exclusions: existing frozen scientific or campaign changes
closure_rule: Resolve every open slot through prospective scientific authority before implementation/binding gates and a separate execution authorization. No null is a runtime default.
